To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a customisable framework for hardware compilation can support rapid design exploration, reusable hardware optimisation, and extensible compiler passes.

a framework for customisable hardware compilation can enable: (i) rapid design exploration, (ii) reusable and extensible optimisation, (iii) multiple levels of abstraction and (iv) transformational development.

(i) a parallel imperative language is a suitable basis for a hardware compiler, (ii) it is possible to build a hardware compiler that supports multiple levels of abstraction, transformational design, compiler optimisation and metalanguage facilities, (iii) the hardware compiler is suitable for the development of high-performance, low-power designs, and (iv) it is possible, using the hardware compiler, to explore different trade-offs in design, and to reuse and extend optimisation techniques
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions.
providing a flexible, reusable and extensible framework for hardware compilation, and with demonstrating its effectiveness for the development of complex designs.

the following: (1) how to support multiple levels of abstraction for hardware compilation, (2) how to enable transformational development, (3) how to enable optimisation by compiler pass, and (4) how to enable customisable hardware compilation.

the framework is very useful for rapid development of hardware designs, but that the design of the framework itself is a very time-consuming process.
the framework is a useful and practical tool for rapid design exploration.
the use of a customisable hardware compiler can be a very powerful tool for the design of reconfigurable circuits.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the hardware compiler is the most important tool in a hardware design flow.
the use of customisable hardware compilers can significantly increase productivity in the design of reconfigurable circuits.
we have developed an integrated framework for hardware compilation, and demonstrated its use in producing designs for a range of applications.

the use of a high-level language for hardware compilation is a viable approach for advanced design exploration.
a customisable framework can be used to support different levels of design abstraction and different hardware architectures, while maintaining a common design flow.
a customisable hardware compiler is an essential tool for advanced circuit design.
